title: No help
body:
Extremely disappointing experience with Mashreq. Every time I have an issue, I’m met with AI on the chat and AI on the phone. There is no actual human support, no one to speak to, and absolutely no one taking responsibility for resolving problems.

I received a refund from Namshi, which was processed back to my Mashreq account on November 1. Today is November 25, and I STILL haven’t received my money. Almost a month later, despite sending multiple emails and making countless attempts to contact Mashreq, my issue remains unresolved.

What makes this even worse is that I can’t even close my account because I have this unresolved issue.

A bank should provide accessible customer service and take responsibility for its customers’ money. Instead, Mashreq makes it nearly impossible to get help or even speak to a real person.

I genuinely do not recommend Mashreq. If something goes wrong, be prepared to chase them endlessly with no proper support and no resolution. Extremely frustrating and unacceptable customer service.

title: Weird
body: I didnt know where to write this review but i need to just talk about the very weird experience i had with this bank. So i was interested in the credit islamic card and i applied online, i received as usual a murabaha agreement where it says ( if you dont reply it means you refuse the application and we wont proceed ), so after some thinking i did reply immediately and told them do not proceed i dont want. After a couple of days i get a delivery notification of the card lol!!!! I tried to contact mashreq bank but well their customer service line is very bad. So i just called EMX and informed them please dont deliver i didnt agree to have the card. So they did. You think i am done? Oh no. Through another bank ( thanks god ), i knew that i have a mashreq active credit card under my name!!! Imagine?. And what is funny? That i tried again calling the bank and two different agents do not want to work and kept transferring my call and just wanting to end it. Telling one agent I AM UNABLE TO CANCEL THROUGH THE ROBOT CALL BECAUSE I DONT HAVE A CARD OR A NUMBER but it looked like she didnt want to understand or help. Of course last option was to email and hope for the best. All of this happened when i REFUSED THE AGREEMENT. HOW!????. And what is funny? They called me because of the complaint and she told me ( ya because you initiated the card so we have to cancel now ) BRO I DIDNT INTIATE OR ACCEPT. Anyway i am so so glad that i didnt open an account or a card with them.

title: Dubai
body:
⭐ 1-Star Review – Unexplained Negative Balance and No Customer Support

I am extremely disappointed with Mashreq Neo.

My account balance repeatedly changes from positive to negative every 2–3 days without any clear explanation. On some occasions, my balance was positive by AED 15, but later it became negative. I have documented several negative balances, including -AED 6.70, -AED 12.29, -AED 14.68, -AED 24.24, and -AED 28.14.

These frequent changes do not appear to follow the monthly fee deduction pattern, and I still have no clear explanation for what is happening.

I emailed Mashreq on 3 October 2026 requesting an investigation, but I have received no response. I also tried contacting customer support by phone and through the virtual assistant, but I could not get proper assistance or reach someone who could resolve the issue.

Mashreq, please respond publicly and explain why my balance keeps turning negative every 2–3 days. I expect a detailed breakdown of the transactions or charges involved, a proper investigation, and a clear solution.

Customers should not have to repeatedly chase their bank just to understand what is happening to their own money.

title: Very disappointed with Mashreq customer support.
body:
Very disappointed with Mashreq customer support.

I closed my Mashreq account, but it is still appearing in Aani under “Send Money to Yourself” even though the account is no longer active.

I have tried to resolve this issue around 10 times through email and also submitted requests through Mashreq’s customer support website. Unfortunately, nothing has been done to actually solve the problem. The only responses I keep receiving are acknowledgements saying that my message has been received, without any proper resolution or follow-up.

The account is closed, so I understand that it cannot be used as a normal bank account. My issue is that Mashreq still has the closed account appearing in Aani, and this needs to be removed/de-linked.

I’m sharing this publicly because I believe customers should be able to get a simple issue like this resolved without having to repeatedly contact customer support and receive the same generic response.

title: Worst Customer Service Experience
body:
⭐ ZERO STARS IF THAT WERE POSSIBLE!

Mashreq has to be one of the most frustrating banking experiences I have ever had. I made a transfer to my friend, the money was deducted from my account, but my friend never received it. 

And what happens when you need urgent help with YOUR OWN MONEY? You are left fighting with a useless virtual assistant that cannot understand your problem, while getting nowhere trying to reach a REAL HUMAN CUSTOMER SERVICE AGENT!

How can a bank take money from a customer’s account but make it so difficult for that customer to get help when something goes wrong?

This is completely unacceptable. Customers trust banks with their hard-earned money, and we deserve reliable transactions, proper communication, and customer service that actually provides assistance instead of wasting our time and patience.

I should not have to spend days trying to speak to someone about money that has already left my account. Where is the customer service when customers genuinely need it? What is the point of having customer support if customers cannot reach a real person when they have a serious problem?

Mashreq, please stop making customers jump through hoops just to get basic assistance. Fix your customer service, improve your transaction system, and start treating customers like their money and time actually matter!

This experience has seriously damaged my confidence in your bank. Extremely disappointing and absolutely unacceptable. I would not recommend Mashreq based on this experience unless these issues are properly addressed.

DO BETTER, MASHREQ! 😡

body: 1. Reaching a real agent by official phone is impossible, which is nonsense. 2. The chat support link they give you sends you to this app, so if you have trouble getting in you will never get a solution - peak stupidity on user experience. 3. The app now says it requires biometrics, but tapping on “go to settings” brings you to the Mashreq settings (on iPhone) where there is absolutely nothing you can set/toggle to enable the biometrics they require. My Face ID is working fine, I’m on the latest iPhone and iOS and yet there is no way to access this app - absolutely ridiculous, let alone the fact that this forced biometrics login is just a random requirement from Mashreq, all competitors like ENBD and Wio (which are both much better in app design and support availability) either let you enter the app with username and password if you’re not using biometrics like Face ID or actually work well with them unlike Mashreq. Stay away from this bank, if they treat customers like that they do not deserve to have any.

title: Repeated loss of my transaction
body: This bank is losing money again and again. Contacting the support service and trying to get your money back turns into a real ordeal, because in the end you spend several weeks just trying to use your own funds. The first time, the ATM ran out of money, and I tried to get it back for several weeks, visiting the bank in person five times, because no one responded to my calls, emails, and chat messages — I was simply redirected to automated responses. I visited the bank in person three times, and even after two official confirmations and the opening of a case, I managed to get my money back only after filing an official complaint. Now I’m conducting an international broadcast from another country, and they’ve lost my money again — even through an electronic transaction.

body:
I am very disappointed with this bank. I checked my account today and noticed that my money was already gone, but I did not receive any clear notification showing where the money was sent or what it was used for.

title: Extremely Poor Banking Experience
body:
Very disappointing experience with Mashreq. Today, my friend transferred AED 200 to me, and the amount was deducted from my friend’s account, but I still haven’t received the money in my Mashreq account/card.

There is no clear explanation or proper support regarding where the money is or when it will be credited. This is extremely frustrating, especially when the sender has already been charged.

I expect Mashreq to resolve this issue urgently and improve the customer support experience. Customers should not have to worry about their money disappearing without a clear explanation.

title: Alternative Login Option Required for Mobile Banking App
body:
Dear Customer Support Team,

I am currently unable to log in to the mobile banking application because my phone camera is not functioning, and therefore Face ID/biometric verification cannot be completed.

Although I know my User ID and password, the application does not provide an option to redirect me to a standard User ID and password login page.

I kindly request you to consider providing two login options in the application:

1. Face ID/Biometric login for customers who prefer it.
2. User ID and password login as an alternative, based on the customer’s choice and responsibility.

Making biometric verification mandatory creates a significant disadvantage for customers whose cameras or biometric functions are temporarily unavailable. It can also be particularly difficult for customers working offshore Remote or in locations where immediate device repair or replacement is not possible.

Please treat this as an urgent login/access concern and assist me in enabling User ID and password login at the earliest.

Thank you for your prompt support.

Best regards,
Varghese

title: Email verification problems
body:
Dear Mashriq Digital Bank and Pakistan Up Team,
I am extremely disappointed and frustrated with the way my issue has been handled. This has been one of the worst customer service experiences I have ever faced

For the past 20 days, I have been unable to complete my email verification. I have repeatedly tried to resolve the issue through the available channels, including sending emails and submitting complaints, but I have received no meaningful response or resolution.

What is even more disappointing is that my emails and complaints appear to be completely ignored. As an overseas Pakistani, I trusted Mashriq Pakistan and made the decision to open an account with your service. Unfortunately, this experience has made me seriously question that decision.

I should not have to spend 20 days trying to get a basic email-verification issue resolved. If customers cannot receive a response to their complaints, then what support is actually available to them?

title: Unable to login App suddenly
body:
Yesterday morning, I was able to log in without any issues. However, since yesterday evening, I have been unable to log in because the app requires me to enable biometrics on my device.

Thank you.

title: Error Creating Account
body:
I have tried more than 10 times to create an account, but it still doesn’t work. I have already activated my credit card, yet I am unable to create an account through either the app or the website.

I also tried calling customer support. Unfortunately, there was no response or resolution. One thing I did notice is that, even without solving my issue, I still receive calls about loan offers.

I spoke to two credit card representatives and explained the problem to both of them. They assured me that they would escalate the issue, but I have not received any update or response.

I also reached out through Instagram, but I did not receive a clear or helpful response.

What am I supposed to do if I am unable to make my payment on time because I cannot access my account? I do not want to be held responsible for late payment charges when I have made every effort to resolve this issue.

I kindly request that someone contact me as soon as possible and help resolve this matter.

Thank you.

title: Very disappointing experience with Mashreq.
body:
A transfer of AED 300 was sent to my account on 27 May, and despite receiving the notification, the money was never credited to my account. I have contacted customer service multiple times, yet the issue remains unresolved.

What is even more frustrating is that I was repeatedly told that the transfer from 27 May and another transfer from 2 June were the same transaction. They were not. I only received the money sent on 2 June. The transfer from 27 May is still missing.

AED 300 may not seem like much to a bank, but it is hard-earned money and important to me. Instead of properly investigating the issue, I have spent days following up and explaining the same situation over and over again.

This experience has seriously damaged my trust in Mashreq. I expected better customer service, better communication, and a faster resolution. I would not recommend this bank based on my experience.

title: Account deductions and lack of transparency
body:
I am not satisfied with my experience with my account. I have repeatedly noticed unexplained or “hidden” charges deducted from my account without any prior notification or clear explanation.

In addition, whenever I transfer money from my savings account to my current account, the funds sometimes disappear or are not reflected correctly. Although I receive confirmation messages that the transfer was made, when I check my account afterwards, the balance shows as zero or the money is missing.

Whenever I raise a complaint about these issues, the response is usually that “someone may have accessed the account,” without proper investigation or accountability. This has happened more than once, and each time I have had to follow up multiple times without receiving a proper resolution.

Customer support is also very poor. Calls are often not answered, and email responses take more than three days, which is unacceptable for financial-related issues.

Overall, this is the worst banking experience I have had due to repeated unresolved issues, lack of transparency, and poor customer service.

title: Extremely disappointed with mashreq neo
body:
Absolutely unacceptable experience with Mashreq Neo.

I opened a new account last digit 9841 and transferred AED 150 just to test how the service works. Instead of being able to use my own money, the entire amount was taken as a “maintenance fee” that was never clearly communicated during the account setup.

After contacting customer support, they confirmed that the deduction was indeed a fee. Charging a brand new customer like this, without clearly explaining it beforehand, is extremely misleading and damaging to customer trust.

A bank should operate with transparency and integrity. Taking the full balance of a new account as a fee creates the impression of hidden charges and unfair practices.

If this issue is not resolved and the AED 150 is not refunded, I will escalate this complaint further and continue sharing this experience publicly so others are aware before opening an account.

This situation should be addressed immediately.

reply.body: Hi Dabicoo, We’re sorry to learn about your experience and appreciate you bringing this to our attention. Please share your details with us at smfeedback@mashreq.com with reference number #581439, and our team will investigate and support you at the earliest.

title: About 15 years behind the times
body: Coming from another country (expat living in the UAE) I find Mashreq’s app difficult, cumbersome and best described as very basic, bordering on the primitive. Examples: No search whatsoever - if you want to find a transaction, you’re only option is to browse through your transactions, one by one. No transaction details either - you get a long, impossible to read transaction string that hides the merchant name somewhere in the middle in between a bunch of internal codes and that’s it. Card functionality is 2005 level - you can set the daily limit and that’s it - no virtual cards or any functionality beyond the most badic, nothing one would expect in 2026. UI and UX are primitive. I guess Mashreq never bothered to check out Revolut or any other decent online bank offering because if they did, they would see that Mashreq is light years behind them.

title: Extremely Unsafe App – Total Security Failure
body:
This is one of the worst banking app experiences I have ever had. My transaction approval system was completely compromised. When I received a notification to approve a transaction and tried to decline it, the app kept showing “Something went wrong.”

Because of this serious app failure, an unauthorized $1 transaction went through, followed immediately by another fraudulent $100 transaction. At the same time, the app refused to open, repeatedly showing the same error and preventing me from blocking my card.

I was forced to call customer service to block my card while money was already being stolen. This is a critical security flaw, not a minor bug. A financial app that fails at the exact moment it is needed is completely unreliable and dangerous.

I am extremely disappointed and do not trust this app at all. Strongly warning others—this app is not safe for transactions.

title: Poor Customer Service and Unresolved Issues – Mashreq Bank
body:
am extremely disappointed with the poor service I have experienced with Mashreq Bank. I have been trying for a long time to contact and receive assistance from the customer service team, but without success.

I personally visited two main Mashreq branches, yet no one was able to assist me with:

Clearing the blocked amount of AED 3, and
Cancelling/removing my active credit card application, which I no longer require.

Because of this unresolved issue, I am unable to obtain a No Liability Letter, which is urgently required.

Despite multiple visits to the branches, I was repeatedly advised to contact customer service. However, no support was provided to help me reach customer service, and I have made several phone call attempts without receiving any response or resolution.

This situation has caused unnecessary stress and inconvenience. I sincerely hope this complaint is reviewed seriously and that I receive a clear explanation and prompt resolution to my issues at the earliest.

I am waiting for a reasoned response and proper assistance from Mashreq Bank.

I’ll not recommend anyone to open acount with them. Save your money & time…totally tension & tension.

body:
I recently had a dispute on my Mashreq credit card, and honestly, I was not expecting that the outcome would come in my favour. To my surprise, Mashreq Bank stood by me and helped me get my money back.

The Dispute Resolution Unit was efficient, transparent, and proactive in keeping me informed throughout the process. Not only was the case resolved positively, but the refund was processed smoothly and without delays.

I cannot thank Mashreq enough for their support, professionalism, and excellent customer service. This experience has truly built my trust in the bank.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a reliable bank that genuinely values its customers.

title: Overall app and the service - Horrible
body: I have been banking with Mashreq for over three years, and the digital experience has consistently been disappointing. While the bank promotes itself as a digital-first institution, the reality is far from it. The app frequently shows inaccurate data, features do not function reliably, and customers are often redirected to digital channels that are themselves broken. There is virtually no real-time support — inquiries take an average of six days to receive a response, and there is no one easily available to speak with. As a customer, this has been an incredibly frustrating and exhausting experience. A truly digital bank must deliver both seamless functionality and responsive support Mashreq currently delivers neither.

title: Not Just Promises. Real Support
body:
Mashreq Bank was the first bank that truly believed in me when no one else did.
They gave me my first debit card despite a low salary, my first chequebook when I needed it for a rental contract, my first credit card when no other bank would approve me — and now, my first personal loan, even when my profile wasn’t “perfect.”
While other banks were overly strict, Mashreq saw potential, understood my situation, and gave me a real chance.
Forever thankful for the trust and support. 🙏
#MashreqBank #ThankYouMashreq #Gratitude #FirstSteps #RealSupport

title: Disappointing Experience with New Face Verification Feature
body:
I’ve been a loyal user of Mashreq Bank’s mobile app, but my recent experience with the newly introduced 6-digit PIN registration and face verification feature has been extremely frustrating.

After logging in, I was forced to set up the new 6-digit PIN, supposedly for added security and fraud prevention. However, to complete this, I had to go through the face verification process. I followed all instructions carefully — removed my glasses, ensured there was no background obstruction, and used proper lighting — but still couldn’t verify my identity.

The most frustrating part? I urgently needed to register a beneficiary to transfer money, and the app wouldn’t allow me to proceed without completing the face verification. It turned a simple, urgent task into a nightmare.

It’s clear this feature wasn’t properly tested before release. Please take user experience seriously — especially for something as critical as banking. I strongly urge Mashreq to review their QA process, bring in skilled testers, and avoid outsourcing without thorough quality checks. Security is important, but not at the cost of usability.

I hope this is addressed immediately. No customer should have to go through this level of frustration.

title: Be wary of this bank and their fraudulent practices
body:
Avoid this bank at all costs. There are much better banks in the UAE that offer much better terms and treat their customers a lot better. Mashreq refuses to cancel my credit card, citing fees that were mentioned nowhere in the app. They claim that these fees are in their terms and conditions on their website, but I never used the website. Currently they're hijacking 25,000 AED while giving 0.15% interest on it (a joke basically) as a collateral for 9,000 AED credit card. If this is not customer deception and theft, I don't know what is. I have moved nearly 1 million AED away from this bank. Banks like Wio will decimate dinosaurs like Mashreq.
I'm still unable to get my money back. They're acting as if the account doesn't exist. Keep your money away from this bank.
author: Pickled Glasses

I just thinking per transaction they cut more then 30 AED wow nice.. and I asked again why you cut my money 2nd and 3rd time, they told me I was purchases something from apple.com that time I was check there is not any purchase. Then I told her (customers care) I didn’t purchase anything they just block my card and send me new card, and they send me 1 dispute from and told me fill-up it and send me. And they told me they will investigation about my account, But still now I didn’t get any information about my money… and this is which type of security??? But Suddenly they changed the policy and start cutting service charges for not maintaining the minimum balance in account 21 AED PER MONTH. This is very unacceptable and unprofessional behaviour. I had no idea about new policy or about charges. They didn't even call or text message for inform us. According to them, they just send an email to inform customers. Wallah they are eating Haram Money. How is that possible that I opened my account only for this condition no minimum balance required, otherwise I didn't open my account. Now they suddenly start cutting service charges 21 AED PER MONTH.Very very bad experience. They are doing fraud with people. title: Low Balance charges
body: This bank initially introduced a promotional offer of AED 1 to entice customers to open zero-balance accounts by transferring their salaries. However, after a year and a half, the bank has implemented a monthly fee of AED 21 for maintaining a low balance. I find it perplexing that the bank began by attracting customers with no charges but has now instituted a monthly fee of 21 dirhams. I am currently in the process of closing my account, and I cannot recommend this bank to others for any financial services.
author: Rizan20

title: The worst banking experience ever!
body: Worst banking experience ever. I tried to open an account in June. They keep asking for my documents. I keep sending the documents. I call them everyday for 3 months. And everytime I call, they will ask me to send the documents. I keep sending. They will even send me message or call that they have recieved the document, only for me to call the next day and they will say we’re sorry please send the document to another email address. Finally they sent someone to come and collect the documents. I thought finally. The next day after the courier guy collected the documents. They asked me to send the same documents again. To yet another email address. This was how we did back and forth for 3 months. Until my Licence expired. One week after my license expired. They called and said they are going to close the account because “I couldn’t provide Licence”. Even though I already applied to renew the Licence, I was too angry and just fed up with the whole thing. I asked them to close it.  Mashreq? Never.

title: Amazing Bank
body:
I’ve opened many bank accounts, but this one has been the best experience overall. Quick and clear process.  The banker came to my home to check my ID, get signature etc. and handed me my new debit card - saving me a trip to the bank, or a long wait. Now I can do almost all my banking from the phone. My friend recommended Mashreq to me when I came to Dubai, and I’m happy to also recommend it. 

My only issue is that I have to click to activate face-rec for login. This is an unnecessary click each time, and should be automatic like other apps.

title: App Fails New Customers
body: Many new Mashreq Bank customers likely join this financial institution via a new credit card. This should make Mashreq Bank quite happy given their aggressive credit card sales program. Unfortunately, the app doesn’t mention ‘credit card activation’ on its front page. There are no prompts, no way to access customer service support through the app unless you either have an active Mashreq account with a current Mashreq user ID and password; or you sign up as a new user. Unbeknownst to me, a loan salesman had signed me up to a Mashreq Gold account years ago. I didn’t get the loan but the account apparently remained active. I never had a user ID or password so I couldn’t sign in. I tried to request new ones but this requires a 16 digit credit card. Can’t use that - not activated yet because I cannot sign in to app. The only recourse for my issue is to seek help from customer service. The app doesn’t provide a method to do that unless you sign in. This methodology (or lack thereof) is flawed resulting in unnecessary frustration. The app is supposed to be the centerpiece of Mashreq Bank customer service. It fails.

title: Fund transfer error and amount deducted twice
body:
There is an issue in fund transfer for this app. It won't allow you to track the transfer done. Moreover there is no transaction log of transfer. 

This is what happened to me... I did a money transfer via snap app. Even after 4 to 5 days the transfer didn't happen and there was no transaction log. Called customer care and they said the request is in progress. After one week called again and escalated. They told the transfer is rejected and to re-initiate the transfer. Second time I did transfer via normal Mashreq website and it happened successfully. After 10 days I found that the transfer done via snap got processed again and money got deducted from my account twice. Called customer care and they said they can't do anything about that and they will take a feedback about this !!!! 
Customer got money deducted twice and bank telling they will just take a feedback ???? That's not acceptable at all. 
Never rely on fund transfer via snap app. Always do via Mashreq online.
